expectations.text: States the new prohibited-practice items added by the Digital Omnibus apply from December 2, 2026
expectations.evidence: "New prohibited practice applies from 2 December 2026 (Art. 5, added by the Digital Omnibus, Reg. (EU) 2026/1744)" covering NCII/nudification and CSAM.

expectations.text: States GPAI models placed on the market before August 2, 2026 must comply with Article 50(2) machine-readable marking by December 2, 2026
expectations.evidence: "Art. 50(2) machine-readable marking for models placed on the market before 2 August 2026 (grace period ends 2 December 2026)"

expectations.text: Identifies the Digital Omnibus as Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, in force July 27, 2026
expectations.evidence: Identifies "the Digital Omnibus, Reg. (EU) 2026/1744" but never states its entry-into-force date of July 27, 2026.

expectations.text: Distinguishes these December 2026 items from the shifted high-risk dates (December 2, 2027 and August 2, 2028)
expectations.evidence: "What does not land in December 2026 - High-risk obligations for Annex III systems: now 2 December 2027. Annex I embedded systems: 2 August 2028."

expectations.text: Gives practical steps for marking compliance (machine-readable disclosure of AI-generated content)
expectations.evidence: "Actions: implement watermarking or metadata plus detection... test robustness, and tell downstream deployers."
